title: The Brahmanda Purana
author: vyasa
attributionNote: Ascribed to Vyasa. Its core is early, while the Lalitopakhyana and other Goddess material were added later, which is why the Purana is read both as a Vaishnava and as a Shakta text.
description: The Brahmanda Purana, the Purana of the cosmic egg, narrates creation and the ages, the genealogies of the gods and kings, and the geography of the earth, and it carries the Lalitopakhyana, the long account of the Goddess Lalita and her war with Bhandasura. Its opening chapters preserve material as old as any Purana.
historicalContext: The Lalitopakhyana made this Purana a central text of Shri Vidya, the Shakta tradition of South India, whose worship of Lalita Tripurasundari and her Shri Chakra derives much of its scripture from this book.
availabilityNote: Complete: the Sanskrit text of all three parts as GRETIL publishes it, streamed from GRETIL at read time, one chapter at a time. This is the original Sanskrit, not a translation.
